items.title: Is Palo Alto “the Most Overvalued Stock in the Market” at Over $300 Billion? Here’s the Downside Scenario
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOne investor on X called Palo Alto Networks the most overvalued stock in the market, at a market value above $300 billion on about $14 billion of revenue. Palo Alto is priced for years of AI-security growth, and Bloomberg’s report that CrowdStrike is in talks to buy Zscaler points to a tougher rival.
